thread:
lina: FYI intake: CVE-2026-3456 in protobuf 3.20.x — RCE via crafted payload. Vendor advisory live. Initial CVSS 9.8, EPSS 0.43. Affects our api-ingest image-builder pinned to v3.20.1.
omar: Got it. Which services are on 3.20.x? Can you dump images real quick?
lina: Quick scan: api-ingest, batch-ingest, metrics-proxy (legacy). Found `github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf v3.20.1` in go.mod for api-ingest.
kevin: If RCE on public endpoints -> treat as P1. Assigning owner. @tara can you take triage?
tara: I'll own it. Checking EPSS/exploit maturity now. ETA ~30m.
tara: EPSS 0.43 currently. There's a PoC on a forked repo — not widespread yet but reproducible from the description. No EDB entry yet.
lina: Does our ingest accept untrusted proto payloads? We have schema validation middleware but it's only shallow (schema-level).
kevin: Short-term mitigations: block direct external access to batch-ingest, add request size limits and strict content-type checks on api-ingest.
tara: Proposed actions:
- WAF rule to reject non-json/protobuf content types to /v1/upload
- Hotfix: update protobuf -> 3.21.3, rebuild images, canary deploy to staging then prod
- Add telemetry: `proto_deserialize_fail` event and alert on spikes
lina: Note: bumping to 3.21 may change generated code. Need smoke tests for grpc wire compatibility. Also, question for KMS team: will rotating signing keys during this hotfix break anything? @infra-oncall
infra-oncall: Rotation shouldn't break runtime unless we rotate envelope keys used to decrypt payloads at ingest. We don't use envelope decryption there — KMS access is read-only for signature verification. Safe for image rebuild.
tara: I'll start a staging canary build with 3.21.3. If smoke passes, canary to 5% prod. Will post CI links.
omar: Timeline? Also need an urgency/impact decision. CVSS 9.8 + EPSS 0.43 — is this P0?
lina: Recommend P1 (urgent). Mitigations within 24h, full rollout within 72h. I'll open a ticket and tag infra + releases.
tara: Opened INFSEC-2345 (hotfix + canary + telemetry). Adding steps and rollback plan.
sec-bot: Alert created: INFSEC-2345 assigned to tara. Reminder scheduled in 2h.
kevin: :thumbsup: I'll queue CI build and prepare rollback image. ETA: build in ~2h, canary in ~6h if smoke good.
tara: If PoC becomes an exploit, prepare client notif drafts. Compliance asks for 90d audit retention for any deserialize failure logs.
lina: I'll draft the customer/internal notice. Also locking down RBAC: during emergency patch only infra-release group can deploy to prod.
omar: Agreed. Reconvene in 2h with updates. Thanks everyone.
